patience.0: Your homepage generation will take longer than additional pages, since we have to create the theme styles first. Other pages will reuse the same styling to make sure the whole site is consistent.
patience.1: Most agency websites take 6 – 12 weeks to complete, but yours only will be done in a matter of minutes!
patience.2: For each page, we create a design mockup, then convert it to reusable blocks that are easy to edit later on.
patience.3: We're crafting unique content tailored to your business — no cookie-cutter templates here.
patience.4: Your site is being optimized for search engines right out of the gate.
patience.5: Every section is built with conversion in mind — headlines, CTAs, and layout all working together.
patience.6: Fun fact: the average small business spends $5,000–$10,000 on a new website. You can redesign yours anytime!

domain.heading: Domain
domain.subdomainChangePaidWarning: Your old URL will redirect to the new one for 48 hours. After that, only the new URL will work. We will email you a confirmation.

domain.updateDnsThenCheckSuffix: . You can also disconnect and try again with a different domain.
domain.waitingForVerification: Waiting for DNS & SSL verification — we check every 15 seconds automatically.
domain.dnsMessageRoot: Add a CNAME for www pointing to origin.cadmus.digital. If your DNS provider supports CNAME flattening (like Cloudflare), you can also add a CNAME for the root domain. Otherwise, set up a redirect from your root domain to www. DNS changes usually take 5 minutes to a few hours to propagate.
domain.dnsMessageSubdomain: Add a CNAME record pointing to origin.cadmus.digital. SSL is provisioned automatically. DNS changes usually take 5 minutes to a few hours to propagate.
domain.disconnectConfirm:
Disconnect {{domain}}?

Visitors using this domain will immediately stop reaching your site until you reconnect it or update DNS elsewhere. Your subdomain URL keeps working.
